integrity: The proof reduces the conjecture to an interval-parity bound and a classical explicit lower bound for the prime-counting function. The finitely many cases \(kn<17\) are checked by exact integer powers; no asymptotic heuristic or unproved prime-gap hypothesis is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves only part (i) of Sun's Conjecture 2.7. It does not address the square-valued interval-count statement in part (ii) or neighboring conjectures. The proof cites the classical Rosser--Schoenfeld bound \(\pi(x)>x/\log x\) for \(x\ge17\); finite computation is corroborative only.
title: Sun's prime-counting root monotonicity conjecture
